_about: Mental-model topic bank (from the user's reference reels, 2026-10-26). creative_brief.py suggests the least-used ones. Each reel tells ONE story that teaches ONE of these, with one takeaway.

mental_models.name: Compound Effect
mental_models.idea: Small actions, repeated daily, grow into massive results.

mental_models.name: Opportunity Cost
mental_models.idea: Every choice costs you the best option you gave up.

mental_models.name: Lifestyle Creep
mental_models.idea: Spending quietly rises with every raise you earn.

mental_models.name: Second-Order Thinking
mental_models.idea: Ask what happens after what happens next.

mental_models.name: First Principles
mental_models.idea: Break a problem down to basic truths, then rebuild.

mental_models.name: Imposter Syndrome
mental_models.idea: Feeling like a fraud despite real achievements.

mental_models.name: Inversion Principle
mental_models.idea: Solve problems backwards: avoid what guarantees failure.

mental_models.name: Loss Aversion
mental_models.idea: Losing hurts roughly twice as much as winning feels good.

mental_models.name: Status Signaling
mental_models.idea: Buying visible symbols to show rank, not for value.

mental_models.name: Parkinson's Law of Money
mental_models.idea: Spending expands to fill whatever income you have.

mental_models.name: Delayed Gratification
mental_models.idea: Give up a small reward now for a bigger one later.

mental_models.name: Cognitive Reframing
mental_models.idea: Same situation, new meaning: change the story you tell.

mental_models.name: Locus of Control
mental_models.idea: Do you believe outcomes come from you, or from luck?

mental_models.name: Mental Clarity Deficit
mental_models.idea: When overload and poor rest leave your thinking foggy.

mental_models.name: Asymmetric Upside
mental_models.idea: Small, capped downside. Huge, open-ended gain.

mental_models.name: The Zero-Sum Game
mental_models.idea: One side's gain is exactly the other side's loss.

mental_models.name: Signal vs. Noise
mental_models.idea: Separate what matters from what is just loud.

mental_models.name: The Law of Diminishing Returns
mental_models.idea: Each extra unit of effort adds less than the last.
